Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1054500. Join molecule_dictionary to activities and assays, and join compound_structures as an inner join. Filter by assay CHEMBL1054500, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
